provenance: Native 1920x1080 Cycles renders, original meshes and materials, geometry-driven laser response; no source photos or image enlargement.
coordinateSystem: Camera: X right, Y down, Z forward; mm
limitations: Synthetic acquisition with a simulated brown lens [-0.18, 0.045, 0.001, -0.0015, -0.008]; approximate radiometry. Accuracy is evaluated against synthetic geometry, not physical measurements.
laserAppearance: Finite variable focus, spatial speckle and soft surface scattering; unmodified blue acquisition pixels
name: Fixed ChArUco board

board.poseSource: OpenCV ChArUco corner detections and solvePnP from these Full HD PNGs

modelNote: Fit laser planes from observed board stripes and known emitter; fit normal components against recorded two-axis encoder positions. Validation evaluates this fitted map within the calibrated command range.

selection.method: Preserve every pose/encoder feature extremum, then greedy farthest-point coverage in normalized feature space (standalone demo: 12 of 50 rendered poses)
